notes: Method: Tier 1 direct HTTP fetch only (sufficient - site is SFCC/Demandware SSR with full product-grid HTML server-rendered, no JS rendering needed). robots.txt: generic 'User-agent: *' has 'Allow: /' with Content-Signal search=yes/ai-train=no/use=reference (permits reference-use fetching); a Cloudflare-managed block list disallows specific AI-training bots (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, CCBot, Google-Extended, etc.) from full-site crawling for training purposes - this project's tier-1 HTTP fetch does not identify as any of those bots and is not bulk-training-crawling, so it proceeded; Claude-in-Chrome (tier 3) was not needed. Checked: sitemap_index.xml -> sitemap_2-category.xml (1976 category URLs, keyword-scanned for christmas/halloween/diwali/easter/valentine/thanksgiving/new-year/mother/father/festival/seasonal/hanukkah/kwanzaa/lunar/solstice), homepage main-nav cgid list, and the ajax Page-SubCategoryContent endpoint for the 'Gifts' nav flyout (subcats: For the Host, Gifts Under $250, Ready to Ship Gifts - no holiday-specific gift subcats). Found and evaluated 5 seasonal-adjacent candidates: (1) fathers-day (cgid=fathers-day) - genuine PLP, title 'Father's Day Gifts', real product-grid/search-results markup with filters+sort, site-reported 'search-results-stats-info' = 4 Results, product tiles with data-pid -> INCLUDED. (2) new-year-sale - redirects (200, 301-style redirect resolved) to /sale-great-deals, a generic storewide clearance page -> EXCLUDED (storewide sale, not genuine seasonal category, boundary rule). (3) seasonal-campaigns (cgid=seasonal-campaigns) - title 'Modern For All Seasons', a marketing landing/collection page mixing indoor+outdoor furniture across all four calendar seasons (spring/summer/fall/winter), not tied to any holiday/festival -> EXCLUDED (not a holiday category; it's a weather-season marketing page). (4) collection-holiday-house-hamptons - title 'Hamptons Show House', a named designer show-house collection/collaboration page, unrelated to the holiday season -> EXCLUDED (proper-noun collection name, not a holiday category). (5) black-friday-* (8 sub-pages: deals/bedroom/decor/dining/event/lighting/lounge/rugs/sofas/sofas/storage) and memorial-day-* (8 sub-pages: 30-percent/clearance/in-stock/lighting/lounge-chairs/office/outdoor/sale/sofas) -> EXCLUDED (shopping/sale events tied to a calendar date, not festive/cultural holiday decor categories - out of scope per rules and per storewide-sale boundary rule). Checked for Mother's Day: no slug/nav entry found in category sitemap or nav; direct fetch of /mothers-day returned HTTP 410 Gone (page existed previously, now removed/not live) -> not included, correctly absent. No Christmas, Halloween, Diwali, Easter, Valentine's Day, Thanksgiving, Hanukkah, Kwanzaa, or other festival category found anywhere in the 1976-URL category sitemap, homepage nav, or Gifts flyout. This is a modern design furniture/home-goods retailer; as expected it carries almost no seasonal decor line - the sole genuine, currently-live, site-taxonomy-recognized holiday category is Father's Day Gifts.
